description: A list and a tuple unify to a list
notes: The spec says list and tuple types unify by preferring the tuple type, which would convert the selected list to a tuple. hashicorp/hcl gives a list because go-cty first tries to unify tuples as lists (unifyTuplesAsList in cty/convert/unify.go, called from ConditionalExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
